---
name: Spec clarification
about: The specification is ambiguous, contradictory, or underspecified
title: "[clarify] "
labels: clarification
---

## Section
Which part of `spec.md` (or another document) is unclear? Cite the section number and quote the text.

## Ambiguity
What are the two or more reasonable interpretations? Why does the current wording allow both?

## Impact
How does this ambiguity affect an implementation or interoperability between peers?

## Suggested resolution
If you have one, propose wording that removes the ambiguity.
